AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming cleaning.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Crocheting Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Water: seedbed pits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
